scripts.studio: npm run prepare-assets && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts && node scripts/prepare-assets.mjs
scripts.preview: npm run prepare-assets && remotion render src/index.ts TUEMotion out/tue-motion-preview.mp4 --scale=0.5 --codec=h264 --crf=20
scripts.render: npm run prepare-assets && remotion render src/index.ts TUEMotion out/tue-motion-4k.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18
